intake.uploaded: Document retained. Review the processing result below.

fx.review: Review the dated conversion before confirming this transaction.
fx.reportingPending: Reporting conversion is unavailable; totals remain in functional currency.
cognitive.reportUnavailable: Accounting report is unavailable before workspace activation.
cognitive.taxReviewMissing: No active scoped tax-fact review is available; tax jurisdiction and event scope need explicit review.
cognitive.noCandidate: No matching intake candidate is available.
cognitive.trace: The deterministic calculation trace and governed evidence references accompany this result.
cognitive.unavailable: The requested authoritative data is unavailable in the current context.
cognitive.explanation.RESULTS_BEFORE_TAX: These recorded amounts describe bookkeeping results; final tax treatment requires the governed tax review.
cognitive.explanation.NEEDS_GOVERNED_REV: Candidate facts and rule suggestions require separate confirmation and governed applicability review.
cognitive.explanation.NO_FX: A foreign-currency candidate needs reviewed FX information before posting; no exchange rate has been invented.
cognitive.explanation.FACTS_ARE_CANDIDAT: Candidate profile facts remain proposals until the existing confirmation process is completed.
cognitive.explanation.DATA_UNAVAILABLE: The requested authoritative data is unavailable in the current context.
product.backbone: Muse understands your activity. Reviewed rules and deterministic engines keep the records.
product.taxUnknown: Your tax amount has not been determined. Review the missing facts and approved rule coverage.
product.startTransactions: Upload a receipt or tell BiG-M what happened. Review the candidate before posting.
product.ruleBoundary: Muse understands. Governed packs supply candidate rules. Deterministic resolvers decide applicability; engines calculate and record. You confirm.
product.packScope: These are context-related candidates, not an applicability or legal approval. Source verification is separate from executable approval.
product.noPacks: Provide the business context before reviewing relevant rule coverage.
product.status.FAILED: Could not finish; review or retry
product.reason.READY: A scoped deterministic result is ready for review.
product.reason.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Business confirmation does not approve tax rules or treaty treatment.
product.reason.MISSING_INFORMATION: The tax event, jurisdiction basis or governed required facts need explicit review. Bookkeeping can continue.
product.reason.OUT_OF_PERIOD: The evaluated rule coverage does not cover this period. Do not extend an older rule silently.
product.reason.MISSING_APPROVED_RULE: Relevant candidates have not been approved as executable rules. An unresolved tax amount is not zero.
product.reason.TREATY_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Cross-border context needs a separate treaty applicability review. A foreign customer does not establish treaty relief.
product.reviewFields: Check the date, accounts, payment and other required fields before confirming.
product.errorMuse: Muse is temporarily unavailable. Showing available deterministic information; use direct entry or retry later.
product.errorFx: A reviewed historical FX rate is required. Other bookkeeping can continue.
product.errorDocument: This document could not be read. Use PDF, PNG, JPEG, text or simple CSV up to 8 MiB, or enter the activity directly.
product.errorPosting: Posting was not completed. Review the candidate and retry the same confirmation to avoid creating an extra transaction.
product.recordedFx: Recorded Frankfurter demo rate; not a new live lookup
product.noReport: No recorded activity yet. Reports appear after confirmed posting.
product.assistantBoundary: Muse explains your confirmed context and recorded results. Amounts come from the engines; rule approval remains a separate review.
product.assistantEmpty: Ask about your business, missing tax information or recorded results.
product.taxQuestion: Why is my tax not ready?
product.reportQuestion: Explain my business results and revenue.
product.demoNote: Synthetic demo workspace. Results use the real engines. FX uses a labelled recorded fixture; live Muse requires explicit opt-in.
cognitive.treatyReview: Cross-border context is present; treaty applicability is not established. Research candidates are not approved treaty relief.
product.demoTaxScope: Demo scope: Indonesian individual ordinary income for 2026. This explores requirements; it does not confirm tax residence or approve any rule.
